B-BR0.Name: B-BR0
B-BR0.Description: Pet that deals damage around you. Each consecutive hit against a target increases the damaga it deals; otherwise, it decreases. Use this Trinket to briefly increase its {{EffectLink|Attack Speed}}.
B-BR0.Quote: Rob's death saddened Yus deeply. She enjoyed watching him work. In a way, it made her feel less alone. She built B-BRO in his honor.
B-BR0.Author: Yua

Blade Storm.Name: Blade Storm
Blade Storm.Description: Deals damage to nearby targets repeatedly.
Blade Storm.Quote: Alix, the swordsworman, loved the Vortex. It was like her: powerful, majestic, and full of energy. Her devotion to the Vortex was such that she designed a combat technigue in its image. Whoever used the Blade Storm would pay tribule to the Holy Vortex.
Blade Storm.Author: Alix

Bleed Aura.Name: Bleed Aura
Bleed Aura.Description: Applies 5 {{EffectLink|Bleed}} to nearby foes, then gives {{EffectLink|Bleed Infusion}} to nearby leapers.
Bleed Aura.Quote: Blood was dripping from his clothes. Not his own. He had killed everyone. It was an act of kindness, nothing else. The coming absorption was terrifying for all. What was the point of living in a world without hope? His aura radiated unmatched violence. He had no rermorse. His last victim was himself.
Bleed Aura.Author: Victor

Bomb.Name: Bomb
Bomb.Quote: It is very important to have a self-destruction system in case something goes wrong. All peaceful models are, of course, equipped with one. If this feature can serve the Leapers, many sentinels would accept sacrificing themselves so that their memory may be absorbed by the Vortex.
Bomb.Author: FREND

BRRR-T4L.Name: BRRR-T4L
BRRR-T4L.Description: Pet that gives {{EffectLink|Brutality}} to nearby Leapers for 10s.
BRRR-T4L.Quote: Who would have thought the factory still had prototypes of reprogrammable sentinels? Certainly not this lynx! Naturally, they would serve her well as perfect little turrets...
BRRR-T4L.Author: Skar

Burn Aura.Name: Burn Aura
Burn Aura.Description: Applies 5 {{EffectLink|Burn}} to nearby foes, then gives {{EffectLink|Burn Infusion}} to nearby leapers.
Burn Aura.Quote: STUPID, RIGHT!? We insisted that Griffin stay away from the explosives. The young rodent was fully aware of the risks involved... yet he took them anyway. And there you have it. A living torch. His fur caught fire so quickly that he had to jump into the cheese waterfall to put himself out. It's just a shame that he never learned how to swim.
Burn Aura.Author: Griffin

Chrono Catch.Name: Chrono Catch
Chrono Catch.Quote: Originally, Chrono Catch was not an offensive ability. When Julie designed this power, she merely wanted to stretch time, to enjoy her children before the Vortex swallowed them: a long embrace for a fleeling pain.
Chrono Catch.Author: Julie

Corrosive Wake.Name: Corrosive Wake
Corrosive Wake.Description: {{EffectLink|Rush}} forward and leave a {{EffectLink|Corrosive}} damage area behind you.
Corrosive Wake.Quote: Nobody had been crazy enough to try implanting pieces of sentinels into themselves, except Pergador. She was ready to do anylhing to avenge her best friend, even if it meant suffering from the venom eating away at her, leaving behind a corrosive trail.
Corrosive Wake.Author: Pergador

Curse Trap.Name: Curse Trap
Curse Trap.Description: Create a zone that applies {{EffectLink|Final Curse}} every 0.5s
Curse Trap.Quote:
Hello.
I am a simple mannequin.
If you read this, it is already too late.
Because it means you are close enough for me to see you.
Curse Trap.Author: Demonic Memory

Cursed Armor.Name: Cursed Armor
Cursed Armor.Description: Protects you from one instance of damage for 5s. Explodes and applies {{EffectLink|Final Curse}} when hit or when the effect expires.
Cursed Armor.Quote: After entering an extreme meditative trance, Achillos developed a technigue to withstand any attack while cursing his gpponents. Alas, his trance lasted far too long, and when he finally decided to stand up, his knees could no fonger support him. Fortunately, the Vortex absorbed his memories.
Cursed Armor.Author: Achillos

Death Orb.Name: Death Orb
Death Orb.Description: Repeatedly damages foes in its path.
Death Orb.Quote: What if she created a mini Vortex, just to see? It was merely one hypothesis among many, nothing major, but perhiaps it could help her undersiand how it all works. All she needed to do was avoid letting it absorb her...
Death Orb.Author: Sigourney

Detonado.Name: Detonado
Detonado.Quote: All her life, Queen attracted anisapiens to her like flies. She was so proud of her \"natural attractiveness\" that she never made the connection between her species — a gecko — and her ability to use electricity. Extremely charismatic, but not very clever.
Detonado.Author: Queen

Ethereal Barrage.Name: Ethereal Barrage
Ethereal Barrage.Description: Throws {{EffectLink|Ethereal Blade|Ethereal Blades}}. You can stack up to 3 charges
Ethereal Barrage.Quote: All these blades... that pierced me... all these Leapers who fought me... I was... one of yours... Why do you keep attacking me...? Why don't you help me...?
Ethereal Barrage.Author: #Error404

Fireworks.Name: Fireworks
Fireworks.Description:
Its explosion lightens and stuns nearby enemies
MY EYES!
Fireworks.Quote: The Captain said the absorption of the island would be the greatest party of all time. He put me in charge of the pyrotechnic displays. After what happened with Griffin, it was better for a squirrel to handle everything. All the fireworks, that's me. The Leapers always ruin the party, though.
Fireworks.Author: Bouboule

Frost Nova.Name: Frost Nova
Frost Nova.Quote: The anisapiens of the Vortex Ring were unaware of the violent cold that inhabited Lele’s island. He brought an entire arsenal to fight the Vortex. Among his favorite weapons was the ice bomb, a kind of homb that grew abundantly on his island. Lele was well equipped and fully intended to win the battle!
Frost Nova.Author: Lele

Fury.Name: Fury
Fury.Description: For 8s: Gain a {{color|n|damage bonus}}, {{EffectLink|Attack Speed}} {{color|n|+50%}} and damage taken +30%.
Fury.Quote: As a lieutenant, Pietro knew how to draw on his resources and accomplish the impossible. He may have taken risks by leaving himself exposed, but his attacks were far more lethal. That was all he needed to accomplish his task.
Fury.Author: Pietro

Goo Bomb.Name: Goo Bomb
Goo Bomb.Quote: Few anisapiens knew that fish droppings stuck better than anything else. Lopo had made it his trademark! He sold his bombs for thousands of shells to the Leapers! Now he was rich, and his boat was far too heavy to maintain its altitude...
Goo Bomb.Author: Lopo

Grenade.Name: Grenade
Grenade.Description: Throw an explosive towards a foe.
Grenade.Quote: Rhodie found herself separated from her uncle after they fled together. Left to her own devices, she had no choice but to develop her own weapons. Simple grenades, against this barren island and its sentinels...
Grenade.Author: Rhodie

L-BR0.Name: L-BR0
L-BR0.Description: Pet that shoots at nearby enemies. Use this Trinket to briefly increase its firing rate.
L-BR0.Quote: There was a time when Rob was responsible for the technical support of peaceful sentinels. He repaired them without knowing what he was doing or who employed him. The loneliness of this strange job weighed heavily on him, and he bent the rules to create L-BRO. It was his first and last creation.
L-BR0.Author: Rob

L-S1S.Name: L-S1S
L-S1S.Description: Pet that shoots when you hit enemies with your Weapons. Use this Trinket to temporarily doubles its projectiles..
L-S1S.Quote: I was manipulated, betrayed, killed. We are all pieces on a chessboard. I wish I had been the queen, the one who destroyed me, the one who stole everything from me. But in reality, I am nothing more than a pawn.
L-S1S.Author: Cleo

Leafade.Name: Leafade
Leafade.Description: Become temporarily undetectable, and your next hit activates {{EffectLink|Brutality}} for 1s.
Leafade.Quote: Victor had killed everyone except her. Alva had managed to escape him by hiding in a bush on the island. He never spotted her. Alva survived everything: the absorption, the sentinels, the Leapers.. Everything except old age. She eventually died hidden forever within the bush.
Leafade.Author: Alva

Mark Zone.Name: Mark Zone
Mark Zone.Description: Triggers nearby {{EffectLink|Mark|Marks}}, then strikes and {{EffectLink|Mark|Marks}} nearby enemies.
Mark Zone.Quote: She had to watch her. Check that everything was in order. Her eyes struck her like electric shocks. How had she missed such a great dissonance? It was her faull. All the better. She would have eternity within the Vortex to remermber it
Mark Zone.Author: Fye

Smokey Dokey.Name: Smokey Dokey
Smokey Dokey.Description: Surrounds you with a thick cloud of smoke, granting automatic {{EffectLink|Dodge|Dodges}} against all incoming attacks except AOEs.
Smokey Dokey.Quote: Kyle would never, ever get caught by the monsters of the Vortex. His special technique was dodging. He was an expert at it. Well he certainly did not plan on getting impaled on an antenna. Yeah... In another life, he would have been more wary of such things.
Smokey Dokey.Author: Kyle

Ultra Laser.Name: Ultra Laser
Ultra Laser.Description: Fire a piercing laser towards the nearest target.
Ultra Laser.Quote: Chaton was uniike other felines. She could shoot laser beams from her eyes. After a while, she became too suspicious and was burned at the stake by her so-called friends. She was cerlanly not a spy. That is nonsensical—BIP BOOP BIP...
Ultra Laser.Author: Chaton

Wind Gust.Name: Wind Gust
Wind Gust.Description: Throws nearby enemies backward and destroys projectiles.
Wind Gust.Quote: No one thought Burp was capable of fighting. That was before they saw him fart. Flatulence so strong it was classified as a \"strong gust of wind\". Well then, no need to debate it: it was an excellent repellent.
Wind Gust.Author: Burp
